title: B2BEnterpriseInvoiceContract
description: Standardized enterprise target contract for B2B billing and revenue ledger ingestion.

invoice_id.description: Unique alphanumeric enterprise invoice identifier formatted as INV-XXXXX

organization_name.description: Corporate client or account legal entity name

item_count.description: Total units or billable license seat count

unit_price.description: Contractual unit price per seat/unit in USD

total_amount.description: Gross invoice billing total in USD

tax_rate.description: Applicable sales or VAT tax percentage (nullable for tax-exempt entities)

payment_status.description: Current lifecycle status of invoice settlement

auto_debit_enabled.description: Whether recurring automated ACH or card debit is active

customer_notes.description: Optional auditor comments or billing annotations
